description: List the spreadsheet tables of the given contexts: every table region of an uploaded Excel/ODS/CSV file is also stored as an SQL table. Returns per table its SQL name, document, sheet, row count and columns (SQL name, original header, type, notes such as 'percent, stored as a fraction', an example value). Use the names with query_table to compute exact sums, counts, averages or rankings.

document_ids.description: Optional: only the tables of these documents (ids from list_documents).

name: list_sheet_tables
